content: We have carbon NMR peaks: 7 signals. Need number of CH3 groups. CH3 carbons appear around 10-30 ppm. Here we have peaks at 26.65, 22.80, 21.35, 19.20. Four peaks in that region, likely methyl carbons. Could be overlapping? Each distinct methyl gives a signal. So likely 4 CH3 groups. Need confirm with proton NMR maybe. Let's get proton NMR.
